instruction.name: movgr2fr.d
instruction.description: Move the 64 bits of rj into fd.

experiments.name: memory-assisted dependency chain
experiments.notes: Derived by subtracting the FPR-store -> GPR-load forwarding latency (9.90 cycles) from the 10.85-cycle chain.

latencies.notes: GPR -> FPR latency is about 1 cycle. The direct round trip movgr2fr.d + movfr2gr.d is 3.83 cycles, so the two directions are not separately observable with a simple round trip; the value here comes from a memory-assisted decomposition.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r5; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r6; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r7; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r8; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r9; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r10; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r11
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; li.d $r5, 2; li.d $r6, 3; li.d $r7, 4; li.d $r8, 5; li.d $r9, 6; li.d $r10, 7; li.d $r11, 8' --asm 'movgr2fr.d $f0, $r4; movgr2fr.d $f1, $r5; movgr2fr.d $f2, $r6; movgr2fr.d $f3, $r7; movgr2fr.d $f4, $r8; movgr2fr.d $f5, $r9; movgr2fr.d $f6, $r10; movgr2fr.d $f7, $r11'

notes: Individual GPR->FPR latency is about 1 cycle. Round trip with movfr2gr.d is 3.83 cycles (~4). Round trip with movgr2frh.w + movfrh2gr.s is 4.99 cycles (~5). Throughput is 1 CPI for 1-20 independent lanes.
